'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Alex Klimenko DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alex Klimenko]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
